package_info.why_malicious: The report does not describe any specific malicious software package or code snippet. Instead, it summarizes threat activity, malware families, and vulnerabilities observed in the wild, but does not provide code-level details or package-level indicators.

behavioral_signatures: Use of stolen code signing certificates to sign malware
Deployment of data wipers (HermeticWiper, IsaacWiper) on targeted systems
Exploitation of Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) for remote code execution
file_indicators: Executables signed with leaked NVIDIA code signing certificates
Presence of wiper malware binaries (HermeticWiper, IsaacWiper, KillDisc)
Files or logs indicating ransomware activity (Conti, Lapsus$)
network_indicators: Connections to known C2 infrastructure associated with Daxin, Conti, or Lapsus$
Outbound traffic to suspicious or newly registered domains
Unusual traffic patterns consistent with DDoS or data exfiltration
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for executables signed with known leaked or revoked certificates (e.g., NVIDIA certificates). Detect the presence of known wiper or ransomware binaries using endpoint protection signatures. Watch for exploitation attempts of Log4Shell and other high-profile vulnerabilities. Monitor for outbound connections to known C2 domains and for abnormal network activity indicative of DDoS or data exfiltration. Correlate endpoint, network, and file-based indicators for comprehensive detection.
